WHO WE ARE
Mercer Landmark is a farmer-owned cooperative with over 300 employees and 20+ locations throughout northwest Ohio. Our team is fully equipped to provide customers with the industry knowledge and expertise they need to make smart, profitable decisions for their farm operation. Our continuous investment in our people, facilities and technology have allowed us to expand our offerings, provide the best service and solutions for our customers and help contribute to our mission to safely and effectively FEED the WORLD.
